source.reason: [CONVERSION] has no core-rules or glossary definition (GW's Core Rules, the Universal Rules Updates and Wahapedia's core rules have none): GW's datasheets define it per weapon, each with its own range (the Faction Pack's Armiger Moirax conversion beam cannon: "more than 12""; its Knight Castellan/Valiant profile: "more than 24""). So the glossary entry gives each weapon's own words, named by the weapon ("Conversion beam obliterator (Knight Defender):", the app's label); the lists have one such weapon. GW's Faction Pack does not reprint the Knight Defender datasheet; the Wahapedia Knight Defender datasheet (the codex) is the only source of these words, which texts.js does not search for glossary entries.
